alternatives: Single language with no Core layer.

entries.issue: Nominal debt versus token amounts and signed integers.
entries.proposedChoice: Amount is nonnegative tokens. Debt is the schema record with controller, debtor, creditor, denomination, principal, accrued, outstanding, dates, allocationRule, negativeRateDisposition, liabilityCap, settlement conversion. outstanding = principal + accrued. SInt is for P&L, funding, and Rate.mantissa only. Transfer authority never creates debt.

entries.issue: Canonical encoding, domain tags, host SHA-256, display.
entries.proposedChoice: Framed SHA256(UTF8(domain)||0x00||canonicalJSON) with domains MORIARTY-SUCC-*/0 including POLICY, EFFECTS, RESIDUAL, ASSUMPTIONS, SUCCESSOR-ID. sourceHash is raw SHA256. Sorted keys, integer strings, no Unicode normalization. Duplicate keys and unknown fields reject before hash. PolicyBody is distinct from PolicyBinding and does not contain policyHash. ProofContext.specVersion is moriarty-succ-core/0; document schemaVersion is moriarty-succ-sign/0. Genesis bootstrap is emptySuccessor zeros then unbornStateBody then GenesisBody.initialStateHash; StateBody has no genesisHash. Inner edges bind successorRecordHash, postStateHash, originalIntentDigest, effectsHash, residualCapabilityHash, originalAssumptionsHash from computed bodies. Display walks schema x-display then ancestor/context resolution. Price mantissa unit is the actual base per quote at scale N, not scaled-integer. debt_id text leaf unit is ObligationId. Missing metadata is an error; values equal parsed leaves. Do not reuse MORIARTY-*-bounded-atomic/1 as accepted successor crypto.
alternatives: Poseidon or native sponge from first successor freeze.

rationale.locator: RP01 co-define canonical signing/display before freezing authority fields. LANGUAGE-DESIGN Mandatory proof acceptance non-circular construction.

entries.consequences: Examples compute host SHA-256 with Python hashlib. Native correspondence is an open check. Old codec.ts is immutable and not the successor evaluator.

entries.issue: Partial fill, cancel, cloned work, recovery.
entries.proposedChoice: Durable consumption is (network, deployment, principal, nonce). Actor-indexed ledgers persist cumulativeGross, cumulativeFees, cumulativeNet, remainingGross, remainingFee. Refunds do not restore gross. Fees count against net. Net goals: prefix must remain achievable, completion must meet originalNetGoal, cancel leaves a residual Duty. Fill and cancel race on ledger currentness. Cloned residual work rejects. Ordinary and recovery work are separate conserved budgets. Ordinary exhaustion never erases debt.
alternatives: Closure deletes residual notional as in a naive episode close.
Net goals checked only at completion.

entries.proposedChoice: One work-unit per charged CoreOp and per B.1 expression node. Default ordinary charge 1, including Exchange, Genesis, DebtAccrue, Migrate. Admission is CoreOp plus expression plus sidecar. Genesis starts 8 ordinary and posts 7. The next one-unit Exchange or DebtAccrue inherits that 7 and posts 6. Signed remainingWork is the actual predecessor post-charge residual. State, prepared, and successor remainingWork after the charge are identical. Do not refresh to 8. RecoveryRight.alias AliasReserve which=recovery aliases remainingWork.recoveryRemaining. It does not copy Work. PartitionReserve is not in the schema. Unknown tag rejects. charge(split) is on the split event. Split and join balances are assigned after charges. Cancel and migrate conserve. Lifetime fields never increase.

entries.issue: Fees versus net goals and gross debit.
entries.proposedChoice: Fees count against net goals. Refunds do not restore remainingGross. remainingGross = originalGrossCap - cumulativeGross. cumulativeInflow and cumulativeFees are nonnegative UInt128. cumulativeNet is SInt128 equal to inflow minus fees, so input-asset fee 30 with inflow 0 is signed net -30. UnsatisfiedNetGoal creditor is the net-goal recipient. Debtor is the authorized payer, not the recipient. Bind asset, deficit, and deliverable backing. Unfunded cancellation rejects.
